normalized.description: The Maynooth University School of Business was established in 2007 and currently employs over 100 academic, administrative, and support staff as well as a student body of over 4,000 full time undergraduate and postgraduate students. The School of Business offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD programmes across a wide range of business disciplines as well as offering a suite of modules within the Arts programme. The teaching and learning experience of our students involves a series of face-to-face lectures within our state-of-the-art facilities within Maynooth’s campus delivered primarily by academic faculty but can also include guest lectures from industry. The School’s collective pedagogical strategy is further enhanced by Moodle, an online learning environment whereby learning materials, supplementary readings, case studies, or other media resources facilitating additional student engagement with individual modules. As evidence from students remains a critical element of our ongoing curriculum review procedures, we require a comprehensive student feedback solution to curate, distribute, and manage live student surveys as well as to analyse and disseminate the collected data.
